Technical skills

 GenAI / LLMs

 LangChain / Agents  RAG / LLMOps

 CNNs / Transformers  NLP / Document AI

 Designed Prompt Engineering workflows with GPT-4 (via LangChain & Agentic AI) and fine-tuned open-source LLMs, integrating Generative AI into enterprise products to enhance automation and customer experience.

 Built RAG pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Qdrant) and developed AI Agent architectures for knowledge search, document intelligence, and automated decision-making.

 Developed Deep Learning & Multimodal models (Transformers, OCR, IDP, Computer Vision) for document/image understanding, including signature detection and feature extraction.

 Built and optimized state-of-the-art vision and NLP solutions (entity recognition, text classification, summarization, Q&A), deploying them as real-time APIs.

 Deployed and monitored LLM solutions on Azure ML and AWS SageMaker, performing image inference pipelines, and applied LLMOps practices for scalability and governance.

 Built Docker images & optimized ML/LLM pipelines, reducing latency and enabling end-to-end AI solutions with cross-functional collaboration.

Projects

 Developed customized image processing solutions which are contributing in data extraction in the product.

 Created and implemented new forecasting models to increase company productivity.

 Implemented the Machine Learning based algorithms like Support Vector Machines to classify the data.

 Suggested the innovative features for the extraction and also implemented the solution into the product.

Machine Learning Intern

ANTWORKS,Chennai	Apr 2019 - Sep 2019

 Researched, designed and implemented machine learning applications to solve business problems.

  Worked on proofs of concept for innovative new solutions.

 Devised and deployed predictive models using machine learning algorithms to drive business decisions.

Insurance Domain – Intelligent Document Processing

  Developed Handwritten Text Recognition using deep learning models combined with Tesseract OCR, enabling extraction from unstructured handwritten forms.

 Built a Signature Detection system leveraging CNN-based object detection models to validate document authenticity.  Implemented checkbox detection using OpenCV and optimized image preprocessing techniques.

  Enhanced product performance by profiling memory usage and implementing fixes, resulting in more efficient processing.

Financial Domain – Document AI & Image Intelligence

 Designed solutions for printed character extraction and key-value pair identification from large volumes of financial/insurance documents.

  Developed pattern-matching pipelines to automate value extraction based on customer-specific templates.

 Implemented photo ID recognition workflows across diverse image formats to support compliance use cases.  Trained/fine-tuned signature detection models with new datasets, improving real-world accuracy.
